sven-acctmgr: FYI customer report — invoice `INV-2026-0091` placed on hold because VAT exemption rejected. Customer says they provided a resale certificate but our system flagged a name/legal-form mismatch (customer PDF shows 'Svenborg LLC' while VIES returns 'Svenborg GmbH'). PO: `PO-7788`. Can billing look?
jess-billing: on it — I see a hold with error code `VAT_NAME_MISMATCH`. Can you attach the uploaded file name and the customer's VAT ID please? :eyes:
sven-acctmgr: uploaded file is `resale_cert_svenborg_2026.pdf`. VAT ID is `DE123456789`. Customer willing to upload trade-reg extract if needed.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0091 status changed to ON_HOLD by automated VAT check (rule: name_vs_registry).
tom-support: quick check — VIES lookup for `DE123456789` returns NAME: "SVENBORG GMBH" / ADDRESS: "Hamburg". Our normalization compares the registry ALL_CAPS name to the uploaded PDF text and treats suffixes as significant.
anna-legal: if the legal form differs (GmbH vs LLC) we generally need documentary proof of DBAs or a legal name variation. Acceptable evidence: 1) trade register extract showing both names or trade name; 2) signed company attestation on letterhead; 3) bank statement/tax doc that ties the VAT ID to the trade name. Without that, we can't accept reverse-charge.
liam-eng: tagging the infra issue — looks like our suffix normalization table doesn't include German<->English mappings (e.g., GmbH <-> LLC). Repro: run `tools/vat-check --id DE123456789 --pdf resale_cert_svenborg_2026.pdf --verbose` and you'll see name comparison failure at step 3 (normalized suffix mismatch). Created internal ticket: INF-3287.
liam-eng: short-term option: we can add a rule to strip known suffixes before comparing to reduce false positives. Will open a hotfix PR if billing wants to allow manual overrides in meantime.
jess-billing: Thanks. From billing policy: we can provisionally clear the hold for this invoice if customer provides trade-register extract OR a notarized affidavit linking the two names. If they can upload by EOD we can process a manual reverse-charge. If not, we'll keep hold and escalate for compliance review.
sven-acctmgr: I'll ask the customer to upload trade-register extract and a signed attestation. They said they can get the extract within a few hours.
anna-legal: If they upload, please include a scanned header showing registration number + date. I'll review docs and sign off. If accepted, I will log an exception and update the invoice notes.
tom-support: For tracking: label this thread `priority:high` and link to INF-3287 for the normalization bug. Also note PO `PO-7788` must match billing remit when we clear.
jess-billing: Escalated to priority urgent. @liam-eng please prioritize suffix mapping PR; @anna-legal we need a quick doc check once the extract's in.
sven-acctmgr: Customer uploaded `trade_extract_svenborg_2026.pdf` (link: https://files.example.com/tx/abc123). Also uploaded a signed attestation (`attest_svenborg_signed.pdf`).
jess-billing: Received both. Anna, can you review? If OK I'll mark invoice for manual reverse-charge and release payment hold.
anna-legal: Reviewing now. The extract shows legal name "Svenborg GmbH" and trade name "Svenborg LLC" as a DBA. This satisfies our evidence checklist. Approving exception for INV-2026-0091. I will add compliance note and close once billing marks as cleared.
jess-billing: Marking invoice CLEARED (manual reverse-charge applied). Noted in invoice history and internal ticket INF-3287 linked. Customer notified. :white_check_mark:
liam-eng: starting the normalization suffix mapping PR now — will include a small whitelist for common translations and a regression test against edge cases.
 tom-support: closing loop — I've emailed the customer that the hold is cleared and what evidence we kept on file. If anything else pops up reopen the thread. :+1:
